adherence.reason: The story centers on a gallery break-in, forensic clues, suspicion, and the identification of the culprit.
Elias Thorne is explicitly a master locksmith and is the story's central character.
Elias is summoned to the gallery after evidence shows that his personal all-access Master tool operated the unforced lock.
The narrative reveals that apprentice Julian spent six months duplicating clients' access tools and selling the copies on the dark web without Elias knowing.
Elias's meticulous Ledger records every piece he cut and cross-references client, date, and tumbler configuration.
Detective Miller is described as testing every portal and its locking mechanism before speaking to a witness or locksmith.
The prohibited word does not appear anywhere in the story text.
The closing sequence has Elias personally replacing and redesigning the neighborhood's locks house by house while refusing all payment and tips.
